name: LeBlanc
notes: Passive Mirror Image is a defensive low-health proc (an invisible clone that deals no damage) and is omitted from gen entirely; it never contributes damage in this fight.

Casts go one after another: Sigil of Malice and Ethereal Chains each have the dossier's 0.25s cast time, during which no other cast starts and no attack lands; Distortion has none but, being a dash, still locks the next attack out for 0.25s like any dash.

R is cast at t=0 before any basic ability, so per the wiki it defaults to Mimic: Sigil of Malice; the opening line is R, then Q (once R's cast time has passed), then E, then W, after which Q and E are recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight.

Mimic's own cast time is undocumented (castTime: null in the dossier); since it 'applies the same effects' as the ability it copies, each variant is modeled with that ability's own cast time: Mimic: Sigil of Malice and Mimic: Ethereal Chains take 0.25s (Q's/E's), Mimic: Distortion takes none but locks the next attack out for 0.25s, matching Distortion.
Distortion's return-pad recast blinks LeBlanc back to her cast location and deals no damage, so it is never used against a stationary dummy; only the initial dash-and-damage cast is modeled.

A single mark slot is tracked on the target: Sigil of Malice's orb and Mimic: Sigil of Malice's orb each place a mark (their own stored value, 3.5s duration) and, per the wiki, consume any mark already on the target for a separate instance of that mark's stored damage; Ethereal Chains' initial hit and delayed fracture (and Mimic: Ethereal Chains' equivalents) also consume an active mark, since the wiki states both of E's damage instances 'can detonate Sigil of Malice' and that Sigil of Malice and Mimic: Sigil of Malice 'can detonate each other's marks'. Distortion and Mimic: Distortion never interact with marks.

Mimic: Ethereal Chains' fracture is assumed to follow the same 1.5s tether-then-fracture timing as base Ethereal Chains, since the wiki gives Mimic no separate duration and states it 'applies the same effects' as the mimicked ability; the stationary dummy never breaks the tether, so the fracture always lands. This delayed fracture is an event, not a new cast, so it does not itself wait on the cast-time gate.
Mana is not modeled: LeBlanc's level-16 mana pool comfortably covers the rotation's costs (50 / 50-100 / 50 per cast) over a 15s fight.
No LeBlanc ability crits (crit_mod is false throughout), matching the wiki, which lists no critical-strike interaction for any of her damage.
